OpenLauncher 3.0 is a big one: a security overhaul from top to bottom, much of the code rewritten, a stack of new features, and webOS 5 support in beta.

### 🆕 webOS 5 support [Beta]
OpenLauncher now runs on webOS 5. App icons show again (they all fell back to the default icon there, #2), and all of its code runs on webOS 5's older browser. It hasn't been tried on a webOS 5 TV by the maintainer yet, and some spacing between buttons can look tighter there. Please tell us how it works on yours in #2.

### 🔒 Security fixes
OpenLauncher can run commands as root on a rooted TV, so all of this was reviewed and tightened:

- **Signed updates.** The in-app updater only installs a release signed with the maintainer's offline key, checked on the TV with openssl before installing. HTTPS only, in a private work folder. Before, it trusted whatever was on the GitHub release.
- **Build provenance.** Every release is built by GitHub Actions with a signed record of how it was built, which is checked before the release is signed. The workflows pin every action to an exact commit and have only the permissions they need.
- **Web debugger closed to the network.** Developer Mode opens a debugger on port 9998 that anyone on your network could use to run code inside OpenLauncher, and so as root. A firewall rule now keeps it to the TV itself, from every start (Settings > TV > Web debugger).
- **Content Security Policy.** Only the launcher's own scripts can run, so an app name, a USB file name, a backup or a web answer can never run code.
- **Root files in root-only places.** The start-up checks and the files mounted into the system (Replace stock Home) were in `/media/developer` or `/tmp`, where any app on the TV can write. They are now in `/var/lib/webosbrew`, and start-up hooks are copied, not linked.
- **Quoted root commands.** Everything sent to the root shell is quoted, so no character in an app id, a path or a name can change what runs.
- **Safer files.** Backups are written to a fresh random file first; app colours from other apps can't inject styles; imported settings are checked.
- **Removed** an unused Home-replacement method that mounted a folder any app could change over the system's Home app.
- **Tip:** Homebrew Channel's telnet (port 23) gives a root shell with no password to anyone on your network. If you use SSH, turn Telnet off in Homebrew Channel's settings.

### ✨ New features
- **Start the TV straight into OpenLauncher** (Settings > TV > When the TV turns on), with a check at every start that puts it back if OpenLauncher is uninstalled or a software update changes LG's file.
- **My wallpapers**: built-in photos, **online photo albums** (Landscapes, Mountains, Seas and lakes, Forests, Night skies, Cities: single photos or whole albums, in 4K), your own pictures, videos and whole folders from a USB stick or the TV's storage, and links. One stays put; several take turns. Each online photo's author and license show in the Now playing card.
- **Your own app icons** and names (Settings > Apps > Names and icons), from USB or the TV's storage.
- **Running apps**: see what the TV keeps open and close one or all of them (green button).
- **Input status**: HDMI inputs with nothing plugged in are dimmed, and a connected device's name (like PlayStation 5) shows on its input.
- **Clock "Same as TV"** follows the TV's 12/24-hour setting.
- **Your look**: Sharp, Rounded or Extra round corners, square to circular app icons, and row spacing for the app menu.
- **Using it without root**: a guide in Settings > TV, and `tools/home-watch` for a second always-on device.
- **Using it with Glasshouse**: see the Readme for which app should do what.

### 🛠️ Rewritten and refined
- **Faster start**: the home screen is drawn from the app list saved last time, the hidden app menu is built after the first frame, and Edit-mode buttons are made only when needed (about 0.36 s instead of 1 s on an LG C2).
- **App menu**: sits evenly on screen, lines up with the bottom bar and the Recent row, stops above Recent when everything fits, and no longer shows scrollbars.
- **Wallpaper**: the built-in looping video is gone (the download is about 23 MB smaller), and the Picture source joined My wallpapers; your choice moves over by itself.
- **Edit mode**: hovering an app shows Hide, Folder, Uninstall and Move as a 2×2 square; names and icons moved to Settings.
- **App info** shows only the essentials, with one place to check for and install updates.
- **Running apps** window with a proper title and a close button.
- **Builds**: every change is now checked and built automatically by GitHub Actions.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.openlauncher_3.0.0_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Dev Manager, Discoverium or `ares-install`, or use **Check for updates** in OpenLauncher's App info. If you set up **Replace stock Home** with an earlier version, press **Apply** again once (Settings > TV) to move to the safer setup.
